_warning: SENSITIVE FILE: the real version lives only in the local working copy and is never committed; it must never be pushed to the public repository.
_note: This file holds placeholders and structural rules only. Real business names, real paths, real flow names and accounts belong in public-safe.denylist.local.json in the same directory (ignored by .gitignore; the script merges it automatically). The category key is the rule category: businessName / realPath / flowName / accountOrServer / privateIdentifier. regex=false matches literally and is escaped automatically; regex=true matches as a regular expression. caseSensitive defaults to false; enabled defaults to true.

allowlist._note: Reserved-domain allowlist: a hit whose text contains one of these domains, which are explicitly reserved for examples and tooling, is not a violation; enabled=false turns the whole check off. Real domains and real mail domains are still caught by the rules under categories.

businessName._note: Business names (customers, products, reports and so on). Real terms belong only in the local override file; this file stays empty or holds placeholders.

rules.reason: Placeholder example: shows the literal-rule format; disabled by default

realPath._note: Real paths are written as regular expressions, so no concrete directory name ends up in the word list.

rules.reason: A real path under the PAD deployment or working root
UNC network share path: the host name is at least 2 characters and the share name does not start with a dot, so a regex literal (double backslash plus a single character) is not mistaken for a path

flowName._note: Real flow names cannot be enumerated structurally, so they are registered one by one in the local override file.

rules.reason: Placeholder example: shows how a real flow name is registered; disabled by default

accountOrServer._note: Accounts and servers: detected by structural patterns, with no concrete host name written down.

rules.reason: Probable intranet host name (internal domain suffix)

privateIdentifier._note: Private identifiers: mail addresses and mobile numbers.

rules.reason: A mail address is a private identifier
